name: Musabetsu Ren'ai ~Boku tte Gangu?~
original_name: 無差別恋愛～ボクって玩具？～
source:
Tomo, a university student, lives alone. One day, Aya, his older brother's wife, suddenly visits his house and robs him of his virginity. She threatens him to report the matter to his older brother and attaches a collar around his neck. She also tells him to keep wearing it for a week and leaves his room.... 

From that day on, where ever Tomo goes, married women compel him to have sex with them. As a matter of fact, Aya posts a paper on the notice board of his apartment, "You can do whatever you want to this boy." Though Tomo finds and removes it, Aya says, "Don't turn it down if someone tells you to do something."

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
大學生智獨自生活。一天，嫂子綾突然來到他家，強行奪走了他的童貞。她威脅要把此事告訴智的哥哥，還替他戴上項圈，命令他連戴一個星期，隨後離開房間……

從那一天起，無論智走到哪裡，都會有已婚女性強迫他與她們發生關係。原來，綾在公寓公告欄貼了一張紙，上面寫著：「你們可以對這個男孩為所欲為。」智雖然發現並撕掉了紙條，綾卻命令他說：「無論別人要求你做什麼，都不許拒絕。」
